title: Use ClientContextDirectory for prepareSecrets on Windows clients
body:

- [x] All commits pass `make validatepr` (format/lint checks)
- [x] [Release note](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/guide/release-notes.md) entered in the section below (or `None` if no user-facing changes)

This fixes Windows remote builds with `--secret` when localapi maps the build context to a Linux path for a Podman machine.

`pkg/bindings` runs on the client. When localapi found the build context on a running machine's mount it rewrote `options.ContextDirectory` to the machine path, and `build()` then created its temporary files (the `--secret` files, a Containerfile read from stdin) under that path on the Windows host, which fails.

Following the review, the client path now stays in `ContextDirectory` and the machine path goes to a new `RemoteContextDirectory` field, which is used only when the local build request is prepared (the `localcontextdir` parameter). The Containerfile, additional build context and ignore file paths are still translated as before, since the server accepts them as absolute machine paths. A caller of `BuildFromServerContext` that already passes a machine path leaves the new field empty and is sent as is. One commit; the earlier `ClientContextDirectory` approach is gone.

Testing:

- Windows client built from this branch against a WSL Podman machine (server 5.8.5): `podman build --secret id=...,env=...` and `--secret id=...,src=...` both build and the secret content is readable in the `RUN --mount=type=secret` step; the stock 5.8.3 client reproduces the original error on the same machine.
- `go test ./internal/localapi/ ./pkg/bindings/images/` on Windows and Linux; `go vet` with the remote and linux build tags; `cmd/podman` compiles for both.
- `make validatepr`

While testing I noticed a plaintext copy of the secret left in the parent directory of the build context after a successful local build. That is the server-side move in `processSecrets` and is already tracked in #29687 / #29724; it is independent of this change.

Fixes #29223

Translated with an LLM from Chinese.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Fix `podman build --secret` on Windows clients when localapi maps the build context to a Podman machine path.
```
